description.p: Laptop fingerprint readers see a small patch of your finger, so a press only matches if it lands where you enrolled. Enrolling every press the same way is the usual reason fingerprint login feels unreliable.
Fingerprint Setup guides each enrolment press to a different part of your fingertip, then tests the result and tells you whether it is any good before you rely on it.
Works with any reader supported by fprintd.
